summary.conclusion: 最推荐本域人工偏好 head＋Audiobox PQ 质量约束；当前先做影子评分，尚不能直接作为已验证的 RL 自然度目标。
summary.evidence: 25条固定10s片段，3个AI评估器与信号诊断已实跑；人工标签为0，本轮没有新RL训练。
summary.scope: 8条既有项目来源（含3组生成前后配对、合成歌声、伴奏）＋2条CC-BY录制参考＋12条受控变换＋3条构造信号。
limitations: 背景Word已完整阅读；文档中的伪影归因与检测断言仍需验证，不能直接当作事实。
短片段、少量内容和手工反例只能发现候选问题，不能估计人类一致性或泛化收益。

limitations: 当前为已有公开模型的代理样本，未验证其代表目标连续隐状态解码架构；不能宣称目标系统已改善。
分数绑定压缩前评分片段；播放器为独立MP3副本。两条录制参考的下载源本身是OGG，未称为原始录音母带。
SongEval Naturalness 指人声呼吸/分句；Clarity 指结构清晰，均不是全混音digital-artifact专用检测。
人工评分只保存在本机浏览器，默认留空；导出后才能分析一致性。

methods.name: Audiobox Aesthetics PQ
methods.measures: PQ/PC/CE/CU, trained scale 1-10; larger is better per axis but PC is complexity；speech/music/sound technical production quality
methods.limitations: mono and 16k miss stereo and >8k artifacts; production quality is broader than unnatural synthetic timbre；weights: CC-BY-4.0

methods.name: PAM
methods.measures: softmax clean-vs-noisy/artifacts CLAP similarity, 0-1 high clean; uncalibrated；TTA/TTM/TTS/DNS general artifacts/noise
methods.limitations: prompt/content bias; upstream stereo reshape; cannot interpret output as human defect probability；weights: MS-PL official msclap model card

methods.name: Frozen encoder + domain artifact preference head
methods.measures: Bradley-Terry scalar; calibrated naturalness only after held-out human labels；user-defined unwanted synthetic artifacts in generated music
methods.limitations: not trained/validated yet; style and generator leakage require grouped splits；weights: encoder dependent; MuQ and MERT are non-commercial

methods.name: MuQ-Eval A1
methods.measures: MI and audio-only TA, nominal 1-5；generated music overall quality
methods.status: 一手核实，未在本轮运行
methods.limitations: single-dataset CV not new-model generalization; audio-only TA cannot check actual text；weights: head declared MIT; MuQ backbone CC-BY-NC-4.0

methods.name: MuQ / MuQ-MuLan
methods.measures: embeddings/similarity, not quality by default；music representation and music-text similarity
methods.status: 一手核实，未在本轮运行
methods.limitations: semantic embeddings can ignore subtle artifacts and encode instrument/style；weights: CC-BY-NC-4.0

methods.name: SongEval
methods.measures: Exact API keys/order: Coherence, Musicality, Memorability, Clarity, Naturalness; tanh*2+3 yields (1,5)；full-song aesthetics, vocals and musicality
methods.limitations: Paper/README Naturalness means vocal breathing and phrasing; Clarity means song structure; neither is a validated full-mix artifact score. Short crops miss structure.；weights: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 project; MuQ dependency separate

methods.name: MuseCritic
methods.measures: five continuous scores in (1,5), critique；long-form song multi-aspect aesthetics
methods.status: 一手核实，未在本轮运行
methods.limitations: vocal naturalness narrower than unwanted electronic artifacts; critique cost and potential hallucination；weights: Apache-2.0 official HF card

methods.name: CMI-RM
methods.measures: alignment and quality/musicality scalar；musicality and compositional instruction alignment
methods.status: 一手核实，未在本轮运行
methods.limitations: toolkit license does not cover weights; overall quality not defect specificity；weights: CC-BY-NC-4.0 HF card

methods.name: SongBench
methods.status: 一手核实，未在本轮运行
methods.limitations: instrument realism can encode acoustic/electronic style; unavailable for production under published terms；weights: same SongBench terms plus dependencies

methods.name: TuneJury
methods.status: 一手核实，未在本轮运行
methods.limitations: instrumental scope and content/style preferences; aggressive optimization may trade fidelity；weights: primary CC-BY-NC-4.0; A1_clap_audio_only Apache-2.0; encoders separate

methods.name: SingMOS / SingMOS-Pro
methods.measures: predicted singing MOS；dry singing voice quality
methods.status: 一手核实，未在本轮运行
methods.limitations: mixture out-of-domain; separator artifacts confound separated vocal scores；weights: public torch.hub checkpoints; verify backbone and checkpoint terms separately

methods.name: UTMOS
methods.measures: speech MOS；speech synthesis / voice conversion MOS
methods.status: 一手核实，未在本轮运行
methods.limitations: music may be penalized as non-speech；weights: checkpoint and fairseq upstream terms should be retained

methods.name: DNSMOS P.835
methods.measures: SIG, BAK, OVRL predicted quality；speech noise suppression
methods.status: 一手核实，未在本轮运行
methods.limitations: desired music treated as interference/background; not music naturalness；weights: CC-BY-4.0 repository; keep artifact attribution

methods.name: NISQA / NISQA-TTS
methods.measures: quality/noisiness/coloration/discontinuity/loudness; TTS naturalness uses separate checkpoint；transmitted speech / synthetic speech naturalness
methods.status: 一手核实，未在本轮运行
methods.limitations: domain mismatch and separate naturalness checkpoint; code license is not weights license；weights: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0

methods.name: Distill-MOS
methods.status: 一手核实，未在本轮运行
methods.limitations: does not validate mixed-music artificiality；weights: MIT official model card

methods.name: FAD / FADtk
methods.measures: distribution distance; optional per-song outlier score; lower is closer；music/audio distribution comparison
methods.status: 一手核实，未在本轮运行
methods.limitations: genre/content/reference selection dominate; no direct per-clip unnaturalness interpretation；weights: embedding-model dependent

methods.name: ViSQOL Audio
methods.measures: MOS-LQO approx 1-4.75; larger more similar；same-content audio fidelity
methods.status: 一手核实，未在本轮运行
methods.limitations: another song cannot be a fidelity reference for a novel generation；weights: bundled official models under repository terms

methods.name: SONICS SpecTTTra
methods.measures: synthetic provenance classification score, not artifact severity；AI-generated vs human song provenance detection
methods.status: 一手核实，未在本轮运行
methods.limitations: synthetic origin is not perceived unnaturalness; imperceptible fingerprints and acquisition/domain shift can dominate；weights: inspect selected checkpoint card; dataset CC-BY-NC-4.0 with extra no-competing-product terms

methods.name: MusicDET
methods.measures: OOD/AI score, not human quality；AI-generated detection via real-music feature density
methods.status: 一手核实，未在本轮运行
methods.limitations: real-music density also detects rare genres/timbres and corpus shift; no proof that lower AI score means better music；weights: verify chosen checkpoint/backbone terms separately

recommendations.name: 2 Audiobox PQ＋有效性和独立音乐性约束
recommendations.formula: q=PQ（高分为制作质量）；整条静音/截短/失败先拒绝。PQ不更名为自然度。
recommendations.normalization: 冻结独立校准集p05/p95映射[-1,1]；不可每batch重标尺。阈值由baseline和真实听感决定。
recommendations.risk: 静音PQ6.735；16k mono前端看不到原始8k以上细节与空间问题。PC/CE不等于音乐性，另报SongEval和人耳。

recommendations.name: 3 PAM＋DSP仅作候选诊断
recommendations.formula: 官方clean/noisy-artifacts prompt softmax均值；本轮7s重叠窗[0,7]/[3,10]。
recommendations.risk: 内容/音量/明亮度影响；自拟artifact prompt严重饱和已淘汰。DSP只解释，尚无自然度加权总分。
recommendations.next_step: 先标两组AM与等RMS gain、正常/明亮synth、低通与失真，再听三组生成前后结果。
